title: sub.error envelope
description: Canonical shape of the sub.error SSE event payload emitted by _sub_session_sse. Both BE pytest and FE vitest validate emitted payloads against this schema.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Must be non-empty.

message.description: Human-readable error description. Must be non-empty.

hint.description: Optional extra guidance for the user or operator.

tally.description: Optional per-event-type count map (string key, integer value).

accumulated_chars.description: Optional count of content characters received before the error.

truncated.description: Optional flag: true when partial content was delivered before the error.
